organizations.publicNote: The National Library of Sweden, whose union catalogue LIBRIS records the Swedish prints.

sources.shortCitation: LIBRIS, Gehrmans C. G. 2601 — “Ninon” (Swedish, Arne Olovson)
sources.fullCitation: B. Kaper and Walter Jurman. Ninon: slow-fox ur Kiepura-filmen “En sång till dig”. Swedish words by Arne Olovson, German words by Fritz Rotter. Stockholm: Carl Gehrmans musikförlag, [19--?]. Plate C. G. 2601. 3 pp., piano with words. Kungliga biblioteket, LIBRIS record 10736215.
sources.title: Ninon — Carl Gehrmans musikförlag, C. G. 2601
sources.creator: Kungliga biblioteket
sources.researchNote: The catalogue gives the first line as “Att ett leende kan vara nog!” and the refrain as “Ninon, låt mig åter se dina ögon le”, with the German lines beside them. En sång till dig is the Swedish title of Ein Lied für Dich. The print is undated; the Swedish recordings of October 1933 date the version.

sources.fullCitation: Dr. Kaper and [Fritz] German. Å, denna tango. Swedish words by Arne Olovson, German words by Fritz Rotter. Stockholm: Gehrmans Musikförlag, [1931]. Plate C.G. 2537. 3 pp., piano with words. Kungliga biblioteket, LIBRIS record 10287378.
sources.title: Å, denna tango — Gehrmans Musikförlag, C.G. 2537
sources.creator: Kungliga biblioteket
sources.researchNote: The catalogue gives the German first line “Schwarze Frack, weiße Weste” and refrain “Du lieber Geiger, spiel’ einen Tango für mich” beside the Swedish “Ej i livlig fandango” and “Å denna tango, förtrollad är melodin”; the date [1931] is the catalogue’s.
